objective: Clarify the report-export task before implementing a bounded fix.
user_outcome: The user receives an actionable export-recovery plan with observable acceptance criteria.

in: Inspect the existing report-export flow and its tests; do not guess file paths.
out: Unrelated redesign, new providers, deployment or global configuration.

acceptance_criteria: Identify the actual export entrypoint and reproduce the reported failure.
Propose a minimal fix and a negative regression without changing the original product scope.

verification.notes: Trait-required and execution-profile checks from .ai/QUALITY.json are added automatically by evidence_gate.py. Profiles change persistence ceremony only. Inferred commands are not executable truth. Borrowing a logged-in browser context requires browser-lease evidence. Skill changes require skill-eval-live or an explicit time-bounded waiver; self-report is not activation proof. Waivers are valid only when human-approved, time-bounded, and pinned to the current finding digest/scope. MCP runtime use requires mcp-surface-pin evidence. Imported/modified Skills must pass skill-security-contract. Durable progress after context compaction must be reverified from evidence lineage; observed stdout is never a verified fact. v5.5 separates product source, task contract, and lifecycle digests; external_pending is structured state and never counts as pass.

locked_decisions: Preserve existing report content and supported formats.
do_not_change: Do not alter unrelated task evidence or model/provider configuration.
unknowns: Actual reproduction input and export entrypoint require inspection.
prompt_context.output_format: Concise plan, changed-file proposal, verification steps, and explicit unknowns.
